claim: adoption/bootstrap-macos.sh --profile macos-arm64-foundation --skip-system-packages ran to completion on a GitHub-hosted macOS arm64 runner (label macos-15, macOS 15.7.9 build 24G830, Python 3.13.15) into a disposable ECO_INSTALL_ROOT, installing the pinned darwin-arm64 archives and npm packages listed in adoption/pins-macos-arm64.json; scripts/adoption_status.py --profile macos-arm64-foundation --json then reported the profile prerequisites_present with no missing command and platform.supported false, and the job uploaded status.json, installed-versions.txt and sw_vers.txt as its artifact.
limitations: Native operation on a GitHub-hosted macOS arm64 runner only; not acceptance on a user's Mac workstation, which must record its own receipt.

platform_profiles[macos-arm64] stays drafted_not_accepted and adoption/manifest.json supported_platforms stays Linux/x86_64; the overall adoption_status is prerequisites_missing by design on an unsupported platform.

No native client sign-in, no launchd service bootstrap, no llama-server embedding acceptance and no Homebrew system-package step ran (--skip-system-packages; the runner image already carried the prerequisites).
npm packages resolve their darwin-arm64 optional binaries from the registry unpinned; the registry tarball sha256 is what the pins verify.
socraticode is the profile's documented unpinned skip and was not installed.
